newsitem.title: UK: LME copper above $2,410 in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper above $2,410 in evening session.

text.p: Three-month copper was bid higher than the kerb close in Wednesday's evening session.
LME copper was indicated at a fresh nine-month high of $2,415 a tonne at 1900 GMT after a kerb level of $2,392 a tonne which was up $42 on the day.
Rudolf Wolff in an evening metal report said with little producer selling today, it seemed that any further buying could easily push prices towards its $2,400-$2,450 technical target.
But it said although the charts remained bullish, the fundamentals were not, especially with the market apparently in surplus in January.
Nickel, the day's top gainer, retested its recent highs of $8,120 by 1900 GMT, up from its kerb finish at $8,050, which was a gain of $200 on the day.
But Wolff said despite today's recovery, a downside correction still seemed possible.
Aluminium was indicated at $1,671, a new 9-1/2-month high, after ending the kerb $22 higher at $1,665.
